statement: At Linux v7.4-rc2 the Pro-specific HID input report is 0x09 and a unified report 0x05 is also decoded. The Pro handler decodes button bytes, a D-pad hat and two packed 12-bit sticks with calibrated Y inversion. Pro-specific button byte 3 carries separate grip right, grip left and C bits; the unified report uses separate mapped bits. Report validity on retail firmware and event values are not measured.

applicability.scope: Linux Pro and unified input decoder
